# Name tree animation classes for the transition state they own

The checked widget uses dashed animating-collapse and animating-expand classes, camelCase animation fields/methods and _hideChildList as an internal verb helper. Recommend preserving that local state naming and one shared hide helper instead of duplicating height/hidden updates across refresh and animation paths. This is an observed component pattern, not a new repository-wide prefix policy. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.

Scope: mail/base/content.
